name: inventory
command: git log -1 --format=fuller; git rev-list --count HEAD; git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository; rustup toolchain list; rustc +stable --version; rustc +1.98.0 --version; docker version; sysctl -n hw.memsize hw.ncpu; df -h .; command -v clang protoc cmake pkg-config; rg --files --hidden -g AGENTS.md -g "*toolchain*" -g "!.git/**" -g "!.spike/**"
peak_rss_scope: max child process RSS (not summed concurrent process tree)
